description: Upload a local file to Telegram Ads and return its media ID. Limits: ad_photo JPEG/PNG up to 5 MiB and at least 640px wide; ad_video MP4 up to 20 MiB, 16:9, 3-60 seconds; website_photo JPEG/PNG up to 1 MiB and at least 150x150. Requires confirm: true and TG_ADS_MODE=write.

path.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to the server process.

name: tg_upload_media
title: Upload ad media
